about.hero_text: Where learning becomes a joyful journey — discover the philosophy, people and passion behind Thane's 1st Thematic Preschool.
about.story_title: A Journey of Love, Learning & Sanskar
about.story_p1: Cocohouse Preschool & Daycare was born out of a simple yet powerful vision — to redefine early childhood education in Mulund & Thane by blending India's timeless wisdom with modern, research-backed pedagogy. Founded by Mrs. Pratheeksha Darak, an educator with deep roots in child psychology and holistic learning, Cocohouse started as a small neighbourhood playschool and has grown into one of the most respected names in early education in the region.
about.story_p2: What sets us apart is our position as Thane's 1st Thematic Preschool — a designation that reflects our commitment to integrated, theme-based learning rather than disconnected silos of subjects. Every fortnight, our children explore a central theme through stories, art, music, math, science and outdoor play — creating meaningful, memorable connections across all areas of development.
about.story_p3: Our curriculum is meticulously aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2022 and the National Curriculum Framework (NCF), ensuring that your child's foundational years are spent in an environment that meets the highest national standards. The Panchakosha philosophy — a 5000-year-old Vedic framework for holistic development — forms the soul of our approach.
about.mission: To nurture young minds into confident, curious and compassionate lifelong learners through a thematic, story-based curriculum that honours every child's uniqueness. We are committed to providing a safe, joyful and stimulating environment where children fall in love with learning — not just for school, but for life.
about.vision: To be the most loved and trusted preschool in India, recognised globally for blending the timeless wisdom of the Panchakosha philosophy with the rigor of 21st-century pedagogy. We envision a future where every child who walks through our doors grows into a balanced, creative and socially responsible human being.

programs.hero_text: From first steps to school readiness — discover the carefully designed programs that nurture children aged 1.5 to 8 years at every stage of their early learning journey.
programs.heading: Detailed Program Breakdown

items.name: Playgroup
items.description: The very first step into the world of structured learning — designed to make the transition from home to school gentle, joyful and full of wonder. Our Playgroup program focuses on sensory exploration, motor skill development and social-emotional growth through play-based activities that feel more like fun than learning.
outcomes: Sensorial & fine motor skill development through Montessori-inspired materials
Story-based learning that builds listening, attention and vocabulary
Social interaction & confidence building through group play and circle time
Independence in basic self-help skills (eating, washing, tidying up)
Exposure to rhymes, music, dance and creative art every single day

items.name: Nursery
items.description: Where curiosity meets structure. The Nursery program builds on the foundations of Playgroup and introduces early literacy and numeracy through our signature Coding Phonics method and theme-based exploration. Children learn to recognise letters, numbers, colours and shapes — all while having an absolute blast.
outcomes: Coding Phonics introduction — 26 letter sounds with actions and stories
Pre-writing & language skills through tracing, sandpaper letters and air writing
Theme-based exploration of seasons, animals, community helpers and festivals
Number recognition (1-20), counting, patterns and basic shapes
Gross motor development through structured outdoor play and dance

items.name: Junior KG
items.description: The leap into formal learning begins here. Junior KG introduces children to the complete 44-sound Coding Phonics system and the Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract (CPA) Maths methodology — a Singapore-inspired approach that builds genuine mathematical understanding rather than rote memorisation.
outcomes: Advanced Coding Phonics — all 44 sounds with blending & segmenting
CPA Maths methodology — Concrete to Pictorial to Abstract progression
Reading simple CVC words and basic sight vocabulary
Numbers 1-100, addition to 10, subtraction to 5, patterns and time
Creative thinking through project-based thematic units

items.name: Senior KG
items.description: The final stretch before formal schooling. Senior KG consolidates all prior learning and prepares children for the rigours of Grade 1 — building reading fluency, writing confidence, problem-solving skills and the social-emotional maturity needed for big school.
outcomes: Reading fluency with simple sentences and short story books
Writing skills — capital & lowercase letters, numbers 1-1000, simple words
Problem solving & logical thinking through puzzles and games
Addition & subtraction to 20, multiplication tables (2, 5, 10), money & time
Comprehensive School Readiness Program — interview prep, classroom etiquette

items.name: Daycare
items.description: A loving second home for your little one — combining structured learning, nourishing meals, comfortable rest and endless fun. With packages from just 1 hour up to a full year, Cocohouse Daycare offers unmatched flexibility for modern working parents.
outcomes: Safe & secure environment with 24/7 CCTV surveillance
Homework assistance for school-going children
Nutritious vegetarian meals designed by a child nutritionist
Structured nap time with sanitized bedding
Daily WhatsApp photo updates so you never miss a moment

items.name: Inclusive Special Education
items.description: Every child deserves to bloom — at their own pace, in their own way. Our Inclusive Special Education program provides personalised support for children with ASD, speech & communication delays, learning difficulties, behavioural challenges and developmental delays.
outcomes: Personalised learning plans tailored to each child's unique needs
Trained & certified special educators with 5+ years of experience
Speech therapy, occupational therapy & behavioural support (on request)
Holistic development approach — academic, social, emotional & life skills
Regular parent-teacher meetings and home-program recommendations
